known_limits_and_risks: All whole requirements are PARTIAL; no complete project, human approval, certification, production activation or external success claimed.
Loyalty requires a trusted LoyaltyPolicy object plus loyalty.enabled=true. Default is disabled. No manual dual-review adjustment/MFA approval adapter or marketplace reward funding.
Loyalty program-row and account locks provide correctness but serialize mutations across accounts. Large-journal projections and capacity are unverified.
No real email/SMS/contact verification provider. Alerts stay pending/provider_unavailable. No sent/delivered effect fabricated; notice-required expiry remains blocked.

Incentives support reviewed single-merchant fixed-cart native coupons only; marketplace.enabled, exact wooshop_offer_id marker and marketplace_plugin product/variation-parent authority fail closed. Product scope, gifts/shipping and mixed-seller funding are unsupported.
Withdrawing rule configuration while preserving native issued-coupon obligations needs the reviewed native coupon ownership/lifecycle policy.
Search is a labelled reduced native fallback with bounded candidate scan (200 per variant); synonyms/external index not implemented.
Measurement arithmetic accepts six integer/six fractional digits; normalization requiring finer precision rejects rather than approximating.
Admin editorial UI is functional typed JSON, not complete field-specific editorial controls. Composite profile values and seller proposals remain unfinished.
No full browser accessibility, no-JS/crawler, provider timeout/MFA, performance/capacity, or backup tombstone reconciliation proof supplied by this worker.
campaign.activation_approved is a new provisional fail-closed gate, not human approval; public history retains history.public_enabled legal gate.
Provider bundles/services/delivery, analytics/connectors, catalog staging import/export, and scanned media lifecycle are not implemented in this worker scope.

Lifecycle execution gating is integrated only for MOD-U003/004/005 in this followup. Root correctly rejects unsupported state changes for other modules with501; availability never bypasses their business/provider gates.

Device-local lifecycle/withdrawal takes effect when a device loads the current server-rendered marker. An offline/open page cannot receive server state synchronously. Consent/module revision tombstones block older pages after the newer marker is observed; server commands always recheck current state.

Wishlist sharing, configuration digest identity adapter, configured capacity above100 and a standalone guest export/erasure UI remain incomplete; account native privacy callbacks and own cleanup commands are available.

Consent event is synchronous after Records command returns; when a trusted caller supplies a larger ambient transaction, final outer-commit event ordering still needs the shared after-commit dispatcher contract before a real external sender is enabled.
